recipes.title: Soft Japanese Tamagoyaki-Style Rice Bran Oil Omelet
recipes.summary: Silky folded Japanese-style omelet cooked gently in light, neutral refined rice bran oil with a hint of mirin, soy sauce, and scallions.

ingredient_details.item: mirin or 1/2 tsp honey with 1 tbsp water

steps: Whisk eggs, soy sauce, mirin, and scallions gently without over-foaming.
Warm rice bran oil in a small nonstick skillet over medium-low heat and pour in half the egg mixture.
When softly set, fold into a neat roll, pour in remaining egg around it, roll again, and slice into tender bite-sized pieces.
tips: Refined rice bran oil is a staple in Japanese home kitchens because its ultra-clean taste lets delicate eggs shine.
Slice into soft pillows that pick up effortlessly with a fork.

recipes.title: Crisp Sweet Potato, Spinach & Rice Bran Oil Breakfast Hash
recipes.summary: Golden skillet-roasted sweet potato dice cooked cleanly in high-heat rice bran oil with onion, garlic, wilted spinach, and soft eggs.
steps: Warm rice bran oil in a skillet over medium heat and saute sweet potato and onion 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until tender and golden.
Fold in baby spinach until wilted and season with black pepper.
Make two wells in the hash, crack in the eggs, cover, and cook 4 minutes until whites set.
tips: Rice bran oil's high smoke point browns sweet potatoes cleanly without kitchen smoke.
Add 2 tbsp water and cover briefly if sweet potatoes need extra steam to soften.

recipes.title: Light Golden Rice Bran Oil Banana & Oat Pancakes
recipes.summary: Fluffy whole-grain oat and mashed banana pancakes baked tender with mild rice bran oil right in the batter and pan.

ingredient_details.note: 1 tbsp in batter, 1/2 tbsp for skillet

steps: Blend oats, banana, milk, egg, 1 tbsp rice bran oil, baking powder, and cinnamon 30 seconds until smooth.
Brush a warm skillet lightly with remaining rice bran oil and pour 1/4-cup rounds.
Cook 2 minutes per side until lightly golden and fluffy.
tips: Rice bran oil gives crisp golden pancake edges without burning like butter can.
Serve with sliced berries or a spoonful of Greek yogurt.

recipes.title: Warm Ginger Scallion Rice Congee with Rice Bran Oil
recipes.summary: Soothing Asian-style silky rice porridge topped with gently sauteed ginger, garlic, and scallions in fragrant light rice bran oil.

ingredient_details.item: finely julienned or grated fresh ginger

steps: Simmer cooked rice and broth together in a saucepan for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until velvety and porridge-soft.
Warm rice bran oil in a small skillet over medium-low heat and sizzle ginger and scallions 1 minute until sweet and aromatic.
Ladle hot congee into bowls and spoon the warm ginger-scallion rice bran oil and soy sauce over top.
tips: Starting with leftover cooked rice cuts congee cooking time from an hour down to 15 minutes.
Naturally ultra-soft, hydrating, and soothing for mornings.

recipes.title: Quick Skillet Rice Bran Oil Oat & Almond Clusters
recipes.summary: Fast stovetop toasted oat and sliced almond topping made lightly crisp in neutral rice bran oil and maple syrup, served over yogurt and berries.
steps: Warm rice bran oil in a skillet over medium-low heat; toast rolled oats and sliced almonds 4 minutes, stirring often, until fragrant.
Drizzle in maple syrup and cinnamon and stir 1 to 2 minutes until lightly glazed, then cool 2 minutes off the heat.
Spoon over bowls of plain Greek yogurt and fresh blueberries.
tips: Skillet granola finishes in 6 minutes with no oven preheating required.
Rice bran oil coats oats evenly so they toast crisp without heavy greasiness.

recipes.title: Japanese Ginger-Carrot Rice Bran Oil Dressing Salad
recipes.summary: Restaurant-favorite bright orange ginger-carrot vinaigrette emulsified silky with neutral rice bran oil, poured over crisp greens, edamame, and cucumber.
steps: Blend chopped carrot, fresh ginger, rice vinegar, soy sauce, 2 tbsp water, and rice bran oil 45 seconds until creamy and vibrant orange.
Toss baby greens and cooked shelled edamame in a bowl.
Spoon the silky ginger-carrot dressing generously over the salad and serve chilled.
tips: Neutral rice bran oil lets the sweet carrot and zesty ginger shine cleanly without overpowering them.
Extra dressing stays fresh 5 days in the refrigerator.

recipes.title: Golden Pan-Seared Tofu & Edamame Rice Bowl
recipes.summary: Tender cubes of extra-firm tofu seared lightly crisp in high-heat rice bran oil, tossed with soy-ginger glaze over warm rice and edamame.

ingredient_details.item: warm cooked brown or jasmine rice

steps: Heat rice bran oil in a nonstick skillet over medium-high heat and sear tofu cubes 6 to 7 minutes, turning until lightly golden.
Reduce heat to low and toss tofu with soy sauce and grated ginger for 1 minute to glaze.
Serve over warm rice alongside shelled edamame and sliced scallions.
tips: Rice bran oil handles hot pan-searing cleanly without splattering excessively or smoking.
Patting tofu dry with a clean towel first guarantees crisp golden edges.

recipes.title: Light 12-Minute Egg, Pea & Carrot Fried Rice
recipes.summary: Clean, non-greasy homemade fried rice tossed swiftly in high-heat rice bran oil with chilled rice, sweet peas, diced carrots, egg, and soy sauce.
steps: Warm 1/2 tbsp rice bran oil in a skillet, softly scramble beaten eggs 1 minute, and transfer to a small plate.
Add remaining 1 tbsp rice bran oil, chilled rice, peas, and diced carrots; stir-fry 4 minutes until hot and light.
Fold scrambled eggs, soy sauce, and sliced scallions back in for 1 minute and serve warm.
tips: Rice bran oil is prized for wok cooking because it leaves fried rice fluffy rather than heavy.
Use a frozen peas-and-carrots medley to eliminate chopping.

recipes.title: Light Lemon-Herb Pearl Couscous & Chickpea Salad
recipes.summary: Fluffy pearl couscous toasted lightly in neutral rice bran oil before simmering, then tossed with chickpeas, cucumber, lemon, and parsley.
steps: Toast pearl couscous in 1 tsp rice bran oil for 2 minutes, add broth, cover, and simmer 8 minutes until tender.
Whisk remaining rice bran oil with fresh lemon juice and a pinch of salt.
Fluff warm couscous into a bowl with chickpeas, cucumber, parsley, and the clean lemon dressing.
tips: Toasting pearl couscous in rice bran oil gives a subtle nutty bounce and prevents clumping.
Great packed chilled for next-day lunches.

recipes.title: Tender Pan-Seared Zucchini Fritters with Lemon Yogurt
recipes.summary: Crisp-outside, soft-inside grated zucchini cakes pan-cooked lightly golden in clean rice bran oil and served with cool lemon-dill Greek yogurt.
steps: Squeeze moisture from grated zucchini in a kitchen towel, then mix with egg, whole-wheat flour, and a pinch of salt.
Warm rice bran oil in a nonstick skillet over medium heat and drop 6 spoonfuls of batter, flattening slightly.
Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side until crisp and golden; serve warm with yogurt stirred with lemon and dill.
tips: Rice bran oil absorbs very lightly into pan-seared patties, leaving them crisp and clean-tasting.
Thoroughly squeezing water from the zucchini makes flipping easy.

recipes.title: Crisp-Seared Salmon & Baby Bok Choy in Rice Bran Oil
recipes.summary: Smoke-free golden pan-seared salmon fillets served over garlicky tender baby bok choy cooked in light high-heat rice bran oil.
steps: Heat 1 tbsp rice bran oil over medium-high heat and sear salmon 4 minutes per side until golden and flaky; transfer to warm plates.
Add remaining 1/2 tbsp oil, bok choy, garlic, and ginger to the skillet with 2 tbsp water; cover and steam-saute 3 minutes until bright green and tender.
Splash soy sauce over the greens and serve alongside salmon and steamed rice.
tips: Refined rice bran oil's 450 F smoke point sears fish cleanly without setting off smoke alarms.
Baby bok choy cooks down soft and juicy in just 3 minutes.

recipes.title: Clean Weeknight Chicken, Broccoli & Ginger Stir-Fry
recipes.summary: Fast, light stir-fry of tender chicken strips, broccoli florets, and sweet bell pepper cooked cleanly in high-heat rice bran oil with garlic-soy sauce.
steps: Heat 1 tbsp rice bran oil over high heat and stir-fry sliced chicken 5 minutes until cooked through (165 F); transfer to a plate.
Add remaining 1 tbsp oil, broccoli, bell pepper, and 2 tbsp water; cover 3 minutes until vibrant and tender-crisp.
Return chicken with garlic, ginger, and diluted soy sauce, tossing 2 minutes until glazed and hot.
tips: Adding a brief covered steam makes broccoli soft enough to chew comfortably without losing bright color.
Serve over warm jasmine or brown rice.

recipes.title: High-Heat Roasted Cauliflower, Chickpeas & Turmeric Sheet Pan
recipes.summary: Caramelized golden cauliflower florets and nutty roasted chickpeas coated in high-heat rice bran oil, turmeric, cumin, and lemon.
steps: Heat oven to 425 F. Toss cauliflower florets and patted-dry chickpeas with rice bran oil, turmeric, and cumin on a parchment-lined pan.
Roast 20 to 22 minutes, stirring once halfway, until deeply golden and fork-tender.
Squeeze fresh lemon juice over the hot pan and scatter with parsley before serving.
tips: Rice bran oil thrives at 425 F roasting temperatures for crisp edges and tender centers.
Delicious spooned over warm rice or cooled yogurt.

recipes.title: Miso-Glazed Eggplant & Tender Cod in Rice Bran Oil
recipes.summary: Silky Japanese-inspired roasted eggplant brushed with light rice bran oil and sweet white miso alongside flaky oven-baked cod.

ingredient_details.item: mirin or warm water with 1 tsp honey

steps: Heat oven to 400 F; brush scored eggplant halves generously with rice bran oil and roast cut-side down 12 minutes until soft.
Flip eggplant, add lightly oiled cod fillets to the pan, brush both with miso whisked with mirin, and roast 8 minutes more until fish flakes.
Garnish with sliced scallions and sesame seeds and serve over warm rice.
tips: Roasted Japanese eggplant turns custard-soft—a wonderful gentle texture paired with flaky cod.
Rice bran oil lets the mild miso sweetness come through cleanly.

recipes.title: Ginger Shrimp, Snow Pea & Rice Noodle Stir-Fry
recipes.summary: Springy rice noodles tossed in clean rice bran oil with sweet shrimp, crisp snow peas, shredded carrots, garlic, and lime.
steps: Soak rice noodles in hot water until pliable, then drain well.
Heat rice bran oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and cook shrimp, snow peas, and carrots 4 minutes until shrimp turns pink.
Toss in drained rice noodles, soy sauce, and lime juice for 2 minutes until evenly coated and steaming.
tips: Snip soaked rice noodles once or twice with kitchen shears before tossing so they twirl cleanly onto a fork.
Peeled frozen shrimp thaws in cold water in 8 minutes for fast weeknights.

recipes.title: Silky Golden Mango, Banana & Rice Bran Oil Smoothie
recipes.summary: Sunny tropical smoothie using neutral refined rice bran oil for effortless velvet texture and enhanced vitamin A uptake from golden mango.
steps: Combine oat milk, frozen mango chunks, banana, fresh lime juice, and refined rice bran oil in a blender.
Blend 45 seconds until glowing yellow and ultra-smooth.
Pour into a glass and enjoy chilled.
tips: Refined rice bran oil is virtually flavorless, making it invisible in fruity smoothies while adding vitamin E and silky body.
Great nut-free way to make a dairy-free smoothie feel creamy.

recipes.title: Blueberry, Rolled Oat & Rice Bran Oil Silk Smoothie
recipes.summary: Clean-tasting purple breakfast smoothie combining frozen blueberries, rolled oats, milk, vanilla, and vitamin-E-rich rice bran oil.
steps: Pour milk, Greek yogurt, rolled oats, frozen blueberries, vanilla, and rice bran oil into a blender.
Blend on high 55 seconds until thick, frosty, and silky smooth.
Serve cold right away.
tips: Neutral rice bran oil lets the pure sweet berry and vanilla notes shine without nutty heaviness.
Adds natural oryzanol and vitamin E effortlessly to your morning routine.

recipes.title: Japanese Green Tea, Pear & Rice Bran Oil Smoothie
recipes.summary: Delicate emerald smoothie blending ripe pear, baby spinach, a light spoon of green tea matcha, oat milk, and neutral rice bran oil.
steps: Add oat milk, baby spinach, diced pear, matcha powder, honey, rice bran oil, and 4 ice cubes to a blender.
Blend 50 seconds until smooth, lightly frothy, and pastel green.
Pour into a chilled glass and enjoy immediately.
tips: Skip matcha for a completely caffeine-free green pear smoothie.
Rice bran oil blends invisibly to give a creamy cafe-latte texture.

recipes.title: Sunlit Strawberry, Peach & Rice Bran Oil Smoothie
recipes.summary: Bright coral fruit smoothie uniting frozen strawberries, peaches, plain yogurt, milk, and light neutral rice bran oil.
steps: Combine milk, Greek yogurt, frozen strawberries, frozen peaches, and refined rice bran oil in a blender.
Blend 45 seconds until thick and velvety smooth.
Serve cold right away.
tips: Frozen fruit keeps the smoothie cold and thick without watering it down with ice.
Mild rice bran oil improves mouthfeel while helping absorb peach carotenoids.

recipes.title: Soothing Papaya, Ginger & Rice Bran Oil Velvet Smoothie
recipes.summary: Gentle digestion-friendly tropical smoothie blending sweet ripe papaya, coconut milk beverage, lime, ginger, and light rice bran oil.
steps: Place coconut milk beverage, papaya cubes, grated ginger, lime juice, rice bran oil, and ice in a blender.
Blend 45 seconds until lush sunset orange and silky.
Pour into a glass and enjoy chilled.
tips: Papaya is rich in carotenoids that absorb well alongside mild rice bran oil.
Cantaloupe is an easy local swap if ripe papaya isn't on hand.

recipes.title: Golden Carrot, Orange & Rice Bran Oil Vitamin Press
recipes.summary: Crisp carrot and freshly squeezed orange juice shaken smooth with a clean neutral teaspoon of rice bran oil for effortless carotenoid absorption.
steps: Pour carrot juice, orange juice, ginger juice, lemon juice, and refined rice bran oil into a jar.
Shake briskly 10 seconds to disperse cleanly.
Pour into a chilled glass and enjoy immediately.
tips: Because refined rice bran oil is completely mild, it adds carotenoid-absorbing healthy fat without altering the sweet citrus-carrot taste.
Serve cold over two ice cubes.

recipes.title: Pineapple, Turmeric & Rice Bran Oil Golden Tonic
recipes.summary: Vibrant yellow tropical press uniting pure pineapple juice, lime, warm turmeric, black pepper, and neutral rice bran oil.
steps: Combine pineapple juice, cold water, lime juice, turmeric, black pepper, and rice bran oil in a jar.
Shake thoroughly 15 seconds until vibrant yellow and unified.
Pour into a glass over ice and drink promptly.
tips: Clean-tasting rice bran oil provides the fat base turmeric loves with zero heavy oiliness.
Diluting slightly with cold water keeps the juice light and thirst-quenching.

recipes.title: Savory Tomato, Red Pepper & Rice Bran Oil Press
recipes.summary: Garden-fresh tomato juice shaken with a splash of lemon, sweet paprika, celery salt, and neutral rice bran oil to boost lycopene uptake.
steps: Add tomato juice, lemon juice, sweet paprika, black pepper, and rice bran oil to a lidded jar.
Shake briskly 10 seconds until smooth and lightly frothy.
Serve chilled over ice cubes.
tips: A teaspoon of neutral plant oil helps unlock fat-soluble lycopene in tomato juice cleanly.
Garnish with a crisp celery stick or lemon wedge.

recipes.title: Crisp Apple, Cucumber & Rice Bran Oil Citrus Cooler
recipes.summary: Japanese-inspired spa cooler mixing pressed apple juice, fresh cucumber juice, bright lemon-lime citrus, and a smooth teaspoon of rice bran oil.
steps: Pour apple juice, cucumber juice, lemon juice, lime juice, and rice bran oil into a jar.
Shake briskly 10 seconds until evenly blended.
Serve chilled over ice.
tips: Combining lemon and lime mimics the bright floral lift of Japanese yuzu citrus.
Refined rice bran oil keeps the finish completely crisp and clean.

recipes.title: Chilled Cantaloupe, Lime & Rice Bran Oil Press
recipes.summary: Strained sweet cantaloupe melon juice shaken bright with lime and a clean neutral teaspoon of rice bran oil for beta-carotene absorption.
steps: Blend cantaloupe cubes, chilled water, lime juice, and refined rice bran oil for 25 seconds.
Strain through a fine-mesh sieve for a pure, smooth sipping juice.
Serve over ice garnished with fresh spearmint leaves.
tips: Orange cantaloupe is packed with beta-carotene—blending with 1 tsp rice bran oil emulsifies it effortlessly.
Naturally hydrating and gentle on warm days.
